scoring_justification: Recomputing mean and std of DS energies from the agent's raw time_series and comparing alignment values to paper references within tolerances.

outputs.description: AIMD-derived defect state energy statistics and aligned level on the RHE scale.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the mean and standard deviation of ds_vs_vbm_eV from the time_series for each trajectory segment and compare them to a hidden reference within tolerances. The alignment values vbm_vs_rhe_V and ds_level_vs_rhe_V will also be compared. The DS level relative to the O2/H2O redox potential will be audited for consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for DS energy statistics and electrochemical alignment from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text and Table 1: PBE+D3 segment DS energy mean 0.83 eV, std 0.33 eV; PBE+U+D3 segment mean 0.37 eV, std 0.20 eV; VBM alignment 2.24 V vs RHE, DS level 1.41 V vs RHE.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's Results section and table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported quantities, faithfully transcribed. No hidden holdout needed.

steps.description: Recompute mean and std of ds_vs_vbm_eV from time_series and compare to paper gold
Check aligned VBM and DS levels vs RHE
Check trajectory durations and VBM-CBM gap averages are plausible
